learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basic concepts of control engineering.
Students know the descriptions of linear transfer elements (differential equation and transfer function).
Students know the behavior of common transfer elements.
Students understand the functioning of a control loop.
Students know common controller types and can tune controllers.
Students can design controllers in the frequency domain and using root locus methods.
Students know the fundamentals of automation technology (control engineering).
Students can create simple control systems using PLCs.

syllabus_topics: Detailed introductory example with simulation practical
Linear control loop elements with simulation practical
Design of state feedback and observers

assessment_methods.method: Participation in practical work and preparation of practical reports
